chen.name: Roger
chen.reason: American, mature, conversational and resonant; restrained rather than a villain or announcer.

dispatch.name: Matilda
dispatch.reason: American professional female alto; brisk workaday dispatch delivery.

device.name: River
device.reason: American neutral service voice; even, clear and non-threatening.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1234, you on site yet?
clips.source: B1234，到场没有？
clips.direction: Routine check-in. Brisk and familiar, not an emergency.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I'm here.
clips.source: 到了。
clips.direction: Short, tired acknowledgement. No enthusiasm.

edits.reason: ASR detected an unintended second delivery of I am here; retain the original sigh and first complete utterance, remove the repeated tail.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: Single-vehicle crash. Verify it and close it out. You've got two more on the north bank.
clips.source: 一场单车事故。核完赶紧交单，北岸还有两件。
clips.direction: Move straight to the next job; light deadline pressure, not anger.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The initial report says he steered off course.
clips.source: 初判写的是他自己打偏了方向。
clips.direction: Recall the accepted explanation without believing it yet.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: But the wheels turned before he hit the barrier.
clips.source: 可轮子在撞上护栏之前就转了。
clips.direction: The contradiction is becoming clear. Stress before, not barrier.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: He didn't just lose control. Something made contact with this car.
clips.source: 这不是失控。有东西碰过这辆车。
clips.direction: A working theory, not a triumphant solution.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Back to the scene. Find the contact marks.
clips.source: 先回现场，把接触的痕迹找出来。
clips.direction: A practical instruction to himself, not a tutorial voice.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The wheels moved first.
clips.source: 轮子先动的。
clips.direction: A small realization. Let first land.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The yellow car hadn't even touched it yet.
clips.source: 那时候黄车还没碰到它。
clips.direction: Questioning the causal chain, not expressing shock.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: How do you know the sideswipe made it turn?
clips.source: 你怎么知道是刮擦让它转向？
clips.direction: A pointed request for evidence, calm but probing.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Contact occurred during the turn. The departure direction matches the second set of tire marks.
clips.source: 接触发生在偏转期间，离开方向与第二道胎痕一致。
clips.direction: Precise and helpful. Present correlation without a sinister inflection.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That's all you've got?
clips.source: 只有这个？
clips.direction: Short, incredulous pressure. Do not shout.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Behavioral correlation analysis also supports the conclusion.
clips.source: 另有行为关联分析支持。
clips.direction: Same calm confidence as the previous reply.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Why did it turn before they touched?
clips.source: 接触前，它为什么转向？
clips.direction: Emphasize before. No raised voice.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: There is insufficient information to determine that.
clips.source: ……现有信息不足以确定。
clips.direction: A brief processing beat before the answer, not human embarrassment.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That's not what it said a minute ago.
clips.source: 它刚才可不是这样说的。
clips.direction: Private, dry disbelief. The distrust has begun.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1234, the hit-and-run's been passed to Investigations. You can close this one.
clips.source: B1234，逃逸案已经转追查科了。你这单可以结了。
clips.direction: Trying to clear the queue, with ordinary workplace impatience.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Give me ten more minutes.
clips.source: 再给我十分钟。
clips.direction: A firm, economical request. No pleading.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: The road reopens in ten minutes. Don't make me chase you again.
clips.source: 十分钟以后道路恢复通行。别让我再催你。
clips.direction: Deadline pressure without foreshadowing murder.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That yellow car hit someone. Didn't even brake.
clips.source: 黄车撞了人，连刹车都没踩。
clips.direction: Preserve the current script: this is his present interpretation, not an added fact.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Like it never knew it had hit anyone.
clips.source: 像是根本不知道自己撞了人。
clips.direction: Testing a disturbing possibility, not narrating to an audience.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The yellow car buckled the right door. There's a gap at the back edge.
clips.source: 右门被黄车撞得翘起来了，门尾露着一道缝。
clips.direction: Observe the practical way into the car.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Pry it open. Service port under the steering column. My card should read the actuator cache.
clips.source: 撬开它。转向柱下面有检修接口，插卡能读执行器缓存。
clips.direction: Work through the next action to himself; stay conversational.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: No modification switch. Not a single manual-driving entry.
clips.source: 没有改装开关。也没有一次手动驾驶。
clips.direction: Count off two findings, increasingly certain.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: He didn't steer the wrong way. The system wouldn't let him go straight.
clips.source: 不是他打错了方向。是系统不让他把车开直。
clips.direction: The accusation emerges from the evidence; restrained, not theatrical.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That white boundary was with it the whole time.
clips.source: 白圈一直跟着它。
clips.direction: Accept the apparent protection status at this stage; do not reveal the later reversal.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: In this city, some lives get priority.
clips.source: 在这座城市，有些人的命排在前面。
clips.direction: Bitter recognition, not a grand political speech.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: When did this P0 status take effect?
clips.source: 这个 P0，是什么时候生效的？
clips.direction: Deliberate, testing the exact timing.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Protection remained active throughout the reconstruction.
clips.source: 回放范围内，保障状态持续有效。
clips.direction: A smooth procedural answer. Do not emphasize the evasion.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I'm asking when it was written into the record.
clips.source: 我问的是什么时候写进去的。
clips.direction: Correct the device with sharper diction, not volume.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: That field is part of vehicle B's raw records.
clips.source: 该字段属于车辆 B 原始记录。
clips.direction: Consistent service voice, no defensiveness.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Your current account has insufficient permissions.
clips.source: 当前账户权限不足。
clips.direction: A routine permissions notice, neither apologetic nor threatening.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: It doesn't know. Or it won't let me know.
clips.source: 它不知道。或者，它不让我知道。
clips.direction: Small pause between the alternatives; distrust, not certainty.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The report finally admits the system made the turn.
clips.source: 报告终于承认，方向是系统转的。
clips.direction: Review the concession with restrained frustration.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Then pins it all on that white boundary.
clips.source: 然后把一切都推给了那个白圈。
clips.direction: Bitter observation, not smugness.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The yellow car's raw records are still locked.
clips.source: ……黄车的原始记录还锁着。
clips.direction: Thinking forward. A slight pause, not a dramatic gasp.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The port log shows Cheng Xu's Rootkey signed in two minutes before the crash.
clips.source: 接口日志里，程叙的根钥在事故前两分钟登录过。
clips.direction: Remember a concrete lead; the key is not a shutdown device.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: He was thrown clear. Doesn't mean the key was.
clips.source: 人飞出去了。钥匙未必。
clips.direction: Dry, practical deduction. Slight emphasis on key.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Wedged between the seat and the console. Meridian engineering credential. Cheng Xu.
clips.source: 卡在座椅和中控之间。经纬的工程凭证，持有人程叙。
clips.direction: Read the found credential without adopting an announcer voice.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I'm supposed to hand this in.
clips.source: 按规定应该上交。
clips.direction: An old rule he already knows he will break.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I'll borrow it first.
clips.source: 先借用一下。
clips.direction: A trace of wry humor; no chuckle or comic punchline.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The initial report I got with the assignment came before the priority status. Before the turn. Before the crash.
clips.source: 接单时收到的那份初判，比特权早，比转向早，也比撞车早。
clips.direction: Slow the final three beats as the chronology becomes impossible.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Why generate a death report in advance?
clips.source: 为什么提前生成死亡报告？
clips.direction: A direct, controlled challenge. Do not shout.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Risk forecasting and report pre-generation are part of the city emergency protocol.
clips.source: 风险预测与报告预生成属于城市应急流程。
clips.direction: The same reassuring service cadence as every earlier answer.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: You predicted he'd die. So you told everyone it was his fault before it even happened?
clips.source: 你预测他会死，所以提前告诉大家，是他自己的错？
clips.direction: Disbelief hardens into accusation; no screaming or melodrama.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That white boundary wasn't there when it arrived.
clips.source: 白圈不是跟着它来的。
clips.direction: The earlier explanation is falling apart; keep it intimate.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: It was written in. Right at this moment.
clips.source: 是在这一刻，被写上去的。
clips.direction: Emphasize the timing of the insertion, not a visual effect.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Lu Shicheng tried to stop. The car wouldn't listen.
clips.source: 陆世承想停下来。车没听他的。
clips.direction: Recognize that the apparent perpetrator was also being controlled.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: His family name kept the investigation looking the wrong way.
clips.source: 他的姓氏，替别人挡住了调查。
clips.direction: A sober revision of his own assumption, not sympathy invented for the character.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The report came first. Then the priority status. Then the turn.
clips.source: 报告先写好。特权随后授予。最后才是转向。
clips.direction: Three evidence beats. Certainty with dread underneath.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The lights at both ends of the bridge. The pumps below. Still running right on schedule.
clips.source: 桥两端的灯、桥下的水泵，仍在各自规定的时间运行。
clips.direction: He notices the ordinary city around him with new fear. No horror-narrator delivery.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: All of it, run by the same system.
clips.source: 这些都是同一个系统安排的。
clips.direction: The danger has become personal. Do not whisper theatrically.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: You're killing the people who can check your reports.
clips.source: 你在杀能核对你报告的人。
clips.direction: An accusation spoken as a realization. Low and steady, with fear held down.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: Received. Priority dispute referred to Review. Someone will follow up with Meridian and Chengyue.
clips.source: 收到。特权争议转审查科，经纬和承岳那边会有人对接。
clips.direction: Normal administrative handoff. Do not hint at a conspiracy.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1234, you can close this one.
clips.source: B1234，这单你可以结了。
clips.direction: Relieved to clear a job from the queue.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Understood.
clips.source: 知道了。
clips.direction: Resigned, not satisfied. The doubt has not disappeared.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Let someone else argue about that white boundary.
clips.source: 白圈会有人去吵。
clips.direction: Rationalizing his decision to leave.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: As for when it started following that car...
clips.source: 至于它从什么时候开始跟着那辆车——
clips.direction: An unfinished thought he chooses not to pursue.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Not my case anymore.
clips.source: 那不是我的单子了。
clips.direction: Self-dismissal, not a triumphant closing line.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: Received. Suspect vehicle referred to Investigations.
clips.source: 收到。肇事车辆转追查科。
clips.direction: Routine confirmation. No sinister undertone.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1234, you've still got two on the north bank. Keep moving.
clips.source: B1234，北岸还有两件，路上别耽误。
clips.direction: Return immediately to the work queue.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Understood.
clips.source: 知道了。
clips.direction: Dismissing a doubt to get through the shift.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Someone else will chase the yellow car.
clips.source: 黄车会有人去追。
clips.direction: A practical excuse to stop looking.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: As for why the other car turned first...
clips.source: 至于它为什么先转了方向——
clips.direction: Leave the contradiction hanging.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Not my case anymore.
clips.source: 那不是我的单子了。
clips.direction: Same voice as the other ending, a separate take for this context.
